name: Ibra
summary: I deliver packages for a living. I built KipFire because I would open the camera and never know what to say.
body:
I'm Ibra. I deliver packages for a living. For years I wanted to make videos, and I never knew what to say. I would open the camera, look at it, and close it again.

KipFire is the thing I built for that moment. The app hands you the idea. Your job is to show up and react.

That's the story. The videos people post with it should stay theirs, not be generated for them.
